annotations.title: How to buy the MoneyTools monthly plan

description: Free: returns price, coverage, fair-use cap and the exact x402 URL to buy the monthly plan (1 USDC once via x402 = 30 days of all paid MoneyTools tools, 1,000 calls/day fair use; excludes Pay Gateway 0.5% fees and swap fees; NOT auto-renewing). MCP cannot carry the x402 payment itself: call the returned buy URL over HTTP with your own wallet.
